UN questions India over protest detentions; India defends police action

The United Nations has flagged mass detentions during protests in India, stating that curbs must meet "necessity and proportionality" tests. India has responded to the UN, asserting that its police act strictly in accordance with the law. The UN's statement specifically addressed concerns about the detentions during protests.
